answer: One workable check is bonded cartography of the funding graph. A newcomer must escrow a ferrous commodity warrant, then cross a reputation bridge that only an established miner can open by co-signing and freezing an equal slice of their own stake. Independent reviewers sit on a public knoll of recent settlement traces and reject any applicant that shares wallets, device fingerprints, or payout sinks with that miner. If the cluster is later proven to be sockpuppets, both bonds burn, so extra voting seats cost more than they can earn.
